repo_version.description: Semver of the catalog itself, bumped on any change to index.json.

updated.description: Date of the last change to this file, YYYY-MM-DD.

count.description: Number of entries in documents (sanity check for consumers).

id.description: Stable unique identifier, kebab-case. Never reused.

category.description: Matches a folder name under docs/, e.g. fema, military, technical-references, other.

path.description: File path relative to repo root, e.g. docs/fema/nims-doctrine-2023.pdf.

tags.description: Freeform topical tags describing what the document is.

apps.description: Ids of consuming apps that should treat this document as relevant. Empty array if none yet.

source_url.description: Original public URL the document was obtained from.

publication_date.description: Publisher's original publication date. YYYY-MM-DD, or YYYY-MM / YYYY if that's all that's known.

last_verified.description: Last date source_url and file contents were reconfirmed against the publisher.

version.description: Revision of this entry within this repo, e.g. 1.0.

superseded_by.description: id of the document that replaces this one. Required when status is superseded.

file_type.description: File extension without the dot, e.g. pdf.
